tasks.short: Evaluate and improve robotic system performance

steps.what: Observe actual industrial robotic cycles under the established safe test procedure, checking quantity, quality, stoppages and operating conditions.
inputs: Actual robot cell and existing safe test procedure
outputs: Actual cycle observations and controller readings

steps.what: Record actual trial identifiers, cycle counts, rejected units, stoppages and observed conditions in the test-record application {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual observations and readings from s1

steps.what: Calculate the defined throughput, rejection and downtime summaries from the actual trial record using native test calculations {OTHER}.
Evaluate actual efficiency and reliability, diagnosing whether robotic programming, calibration, tooling or process conditions explain the performance.
Prepare the actual revised robot program or calibration settings in the offline controller workspace {OTHER}, retaining the known prior configuration.
inputs: Current controller program and calibration references
outputs: Complete proposed configuration v1 and rollback copy

steps.what: Review the complete proposed configuration and safe test arrangements, authorising that exact configuration for controlled installation and testing or returning defects.
inputs: Complete configuration v1 and rollback copy from s5
Existing safe installation and test procedure
outputs: Independent authorisation for controlled installation of v1

steps.what: Load the authorised configuration into the isolated robot controller {OTHER} for the controlled test.
outputs: Installed configuration v1 under test controls

steps.what: Perform actual calibration and acceptance trials under the safe procedure, checking quality, repeatability and protective behaviour before deciding whether the installed configuration can return to operation.
inputs: Approved test criteria and actual cell condition
outputs: Actual test results and return-to-operation decision for installed v1

steps.what: Return only the successfully tested robot configuration to operation through the existing controller procedure {OTHER}.
inputs: Successful actual test and return decision from s8

steps.what: Write the actual adjustment, tests and resulting quantity/quality observations in the maintenance record {OTHER}.
Save the actual change history in the same maintenance record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native test summaries in {OTHER} from actual recorded trials. Diagnosis, reprogramming, calibration and physical acceptance remain human; consequential controller changes use the existing engineering and safe-test authorisations, while the maintenance-note save is ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual performance summaries can obscure which trial conditions produced a result.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calculations can summarise explicit trial fields without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Faster motion can worsen reliability, product quality or physical safety.
tasks.human_edge: Connect the measured result to physical robot behaviour and safe calibration.

ambition.what: Improve traceability of the actual adjustment trial.

tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic, with programming and safe acceptance responsibility unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish robot cycle changes from upstream material and quality effects.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for test records and engineering controls

evidence.claim: Structured trial records support deterministic throughput and rejection summaries; robot diagnosis and safe adjustments remain human work.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual observation, separate trial capture, analysis, reprogramming/calibration, controlled testing and history recording. No automatic robot tuning or protective control is introduced.

s2 produces trial id, robot/program version, duration, cycles, accepted/rejected counts and stoppages. Existing engineer-approved formulas define the metrics. Missing fields require manual analysis. Native calculations are tested first; existing runtime earns no saving.

Conditional E1 shares include the usual responsible-engineer check at 8 other-role shares; the technician baseline is 92 and its saving excludes that unchanged review. Use only where this existing installation/test authority chain applies, otherwise retain the site's actual controls without claiming less work.

s6 authorises the complete s5 candidate, not an author's own notes. Any revision voids a1. s8's actual physical safety acceptance authorises operation of that exact tested installed state; any further adjustment repeats the controls. Routine same-system history storage is 1% fully retained without a self-gate.
unknowns: What installation and return-to-service roles are authorised at this site?
research_questions: Do summaries preserve trial comparability across product mix and program versions?

already_counted.description: Actual technician observations, capture, diagnosis, adjustment, trials and records

incremental.description: Validate metric definitions and version grouping after test changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact configuration v1 from s5, independently authorised for controlled installation in s6; any edit voids it
Exact installed configuration v1 and actual successful test state at the end of s8; any adjustment requires fresh acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Technician gross 10/92*100 = 10.87 minus 1 upkeep gives 9.87; high rounded down to 9.8. Conservative case: trials differ in product mix or metric definitions and cannot be grouped validly, so retain manual analysis without adopting summaries. Actual observation, adjustment and safe tests stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train people to install, use and maintain robots

steps.what: Locate the exact robot model, controller version and approved installation/use/maintenance instructions in {DOCS}.
Prepare the actual safe demonstration and practice setup for the customer's or personnel's assigned tasks.
inputs: Actual robot setup and learner tasks

steps.what: Train customers or personnel to install, use or maintain the robot, demonstrating procedures and observing their actual supervised practice.
Record actual topics covered, observed difficulties and required follow-up in the training record {DOCS} after practice.
inputs: Actual instruction and observations from s3

steps.what: Save the actual training record in the same {DOCS} workspace.

tasks.design: Configure robot-model and controller-version views of approved instructions in {DOCS}. The technician prepares the physical setup, teaches and observes actual practice, then writes the actual training record; no model certifies competence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions for similar robot/controller versions can be difficult to distinguish.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version filters can narrow retrieval to the actual installed equipment.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing a procedure verbally does not establish safe physical practice.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise unsafe behaviour and adapt demonstrations to the learner.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation, with training responsibility unchanged.

reach.role: Electro-Mechanical and Mechatronics Technologists and Technicians
reach.learn: Use observed practice to identify task-specific follow-up.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for technical documents and training records

evidence.claim: Native model/version filters can locate approved robot instructions; actual practical training remains human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual source retrieval, safe setup, teaching and a separate post-training record. No invented course scheduling or attendance administration is added.

Existing document owners provide robot model, controller version, document revision and approved procedure. The technician checks actual equipment identity in s1. Missing version information means manual source checking with no retrieval saving.
Conditional E1 shares; only navigation changes. Native document settings are tested first, and existing runtime earns no saving. The internal record save is fully retained and ungated.
research_questions: Does the source view prevent selection of the wrong controller-version procedure?

already_counted.description: Source checks, actual setup, instruction, observed practice and completion record

incremental.description: Check model/version tags after instruction changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 2 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 1.5. Conservative case: customer-specific robot modifications make the standard version collection insufficient; retain manual source matching and all physical teaching rather than adopting the view.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document robotic test procedures and results

steps.what: Gather and verify the actual robot test method, run identifiers, controller versions, measured results and technician observations from the test-record software {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual approved test method, instrument exports and contemporaneous technician observations

steps.what: Write the actual robotics test procedure and results narrative in the controlled report {DOCS}, describing deviations and limitations.
inputs: Verified actual source package from s1

loop.purpose: Draft source-linked procedure and results prose
loop.input: Actual method, observations and run records selected in s1
loop.output: Draft prose with source references and unresolved gaps
loop.check: Technician checks actual sequence, deviations, limitations and meaning against original records in s5
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; missing facts remain flagged and writing returns to the technician
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates are used first; explaining actual test deviations and limitations requires narrative composition rather than field copying.

steps.what: Fill the actual numerical test-result tables from verified result exports using native report generation {OTHER}.
inputs: Verified actual results and run identifiers from s1

steps.what: Generate the specified test figures from the verified measurements using native chart definitions {OTHER}.
inputs: Existing defined chart axes and units

steps.what: Assemble and check the actual report in {DOCS}, verifying the procedure meaning, deviations, numbers, figure units, run identity and limitations against original test records.
outputs: Corrected complete test procedure and results report

steps.what: Save the corrected test report in the same {DOCS} project workspace.
outputs: Saved actual test procedure and results report

tasks.design: Use native test-report tables and charts in {OTHER} and a controlled {DOCS} template. A bounded loop drafts only source-linked procedure/results prose; the technician checks the completed report, and ordinary storage has no added approval stage.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual test records are manually reformatted into tables, figures and narrative.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report generation handles explicit measurements, while a bounded drafting loop can compose prose from actual recorded deviations.
tasks.still_hard: An apparently successful run may have used the wrong configuration or omitted an important deviation.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the test actually establishes and what it does not.

ambition.what: Provide a traceable procedure-and-results bundle for robot commissioning handover.

tasks.altitude: Less reformatting; technical interpretation and record responsibility remain.

reach.learn: Present repeatability, limitations and exact configuration lineage.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for test sources and permitted model use

evidence.claim: Native test-report generation can populate numerical tables and figures; narrative drafts require source-based human checking.

assumptions: Boundary is documentation of actual tests and their procedures. The existing test workflow supplies the approved method, actual instrument exports and contemporaneous observations today; collection and testing remain unchanged with no saving claimed here. s1 includes checking and completing the actual source package.

Required fields are test id, robot id, controller/program version, method revision, measured parameter, value, unit, time and observed deviations. The technician verifies these in s1. Missing or handwritten results are manually entered and checked; no free extraction or invented procedure is assumed.

Conditional E1 shares apply where tables and charts are manually prepared today. Native generator settings are tested first; existing automatic report runtime earns no saving. The report is an internal technical record, not a release-to-production decision. Its save is 1% retained and ungated.
unknowns: Are result exports and chart definitions compatible with native reporting?
How much prose is already templated?
research_questions: Can every figure and procedural statement be traced to the actual run and method revision?

already_counted.description: Actual source-package verification, prose review and complete report checking

incremental.description: Maintain export/chart mappings and audit narrative omissions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 35*0.30 + 25 + 10 = 45.5 minus 3 upkeep gives 42.5. Conservative case: incompatible result metadata and heavily modified test methods require manual tables, figures and full prose rewriting; retain the present documentation process instead of adopting this generator. Source verification and complete technical checking remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist engineers with robotic system design and configuration

steps.what: Clarify the engineer's actual robotic design, configuration or application problem and the technician's assigned contribution.
inputs: Actual engineer's design brief and constraints

steps.what: Locate the exact robot, tooling and interface specifications relevant to the assigned design in {DOCS}.
Assist with actual component fit, bench configuration and application trials under the engineer's established safe development procedure.
inputs: Actual robotic development equipment and offline configuration tools {OTHER}

steps.what: Write the actual configuration details, fit problems and trial observations in the design working record {DOCS} for the engineer.
inputs: Actual contribution and observations from s3

steps.what: Save the working record in the same {DOCS} design workspace.

tasks.design: Configure native model/version filters in {DOCS} to find the actual robot and tooling specifications. The technician still helps the engineer with physical fit, bench configuration, application trials and the separate technical record; this does not automate production configuration release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Similar component and controller documents make source matching slow.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata filters can expose exact technical versions.
tasks.still_hard: Nominal compatibility does not establish practical fit or safe behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: Notice mechanical and operational details that are absent from nominal specifications.

ambition.what: Protect actual design-assistance and bench-trial time.

tasks.altitude: Only source navigation changes; engineering decision rights stay with the engineer.

reach.learn: Connect physical integration observations with testable design constraints.

evidence.claim: Native technical-document filters can reduce source navigation; actual robotic design assistance remains human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual engineer consultation, specification lookup, development assistance and its working record. Any consequential production controller installation follows its existing separate safe authorisation process with no labour reduction claimed here.

Existing document owners provide robot model, controller version, tooling id and specification revision. s1 supplies the actual scope; s2 checks source applicability. Unidentified or modified components require manual investigation.

Conditional E1 shares. Native filters precede custom retrieval and only navigation is reduced. Actual bench work and new findings writing remain fully retained. The ordinary working-record save has no approval stage.
unknowns: Can specifications be matched to the actual modified equipment?
research_questions: Does the filtered source collection reduce wrong-version lookups without hiding custom modifications?

already_counted.description: Consultation, source relevance checks, actual design assistance and record writing

incremental.description: Maintain component and controller-version source tags

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 2 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 1.5. Conservative case: custom tooling has no reliable version metadata, so retain full manual specification matching and the existing bench assistance process without adding the filtered view.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated calculation and test-report formatting, while retaining physical robot work and engineering coordination.
reach: Help robotics engineers connect physical integration findings with explicit test constraints
role.ambitious_version: Robot improvements supported by exact configuration records and defensible test evidence.
